verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support for this story. Reflect has keyboard-triggered editor actions (`[[` for links, `cmd j` for the AI palette), users can upload images and files into notes, and community users call the editor fast and easy to use. Nothing documents headings, callouts, tables or code blocks. Missing for 10: documented support for headings, callouts, tables and code blocks; documentation of embedding media beyond file/image uploads; a documented keyboard-shortcut or slash-command formatting system; hands-on corroboration of formatting depth.
